find: return Math.min(Math.max(want, chip.bottom - height), chip.top - header)
title: moves the page down for a panel above its chip under the header, as far as the chip still fits
why: The lower clamp removed: a panel above a chip near the window's foot moves the page down by its overlap with the header and takes the chip out of the window.

find: return Math.min(Math.max(want, chip.bottom - height), chip.top - header)
replace: return Math.min(Math.max(want, chip.bottom - height), top - header)
title: brings back a chip already past the foot, though its panel above runs under the header
why: The upper clamp taken from the panel's top instead of the chip's, as the first fix had it: with both overrunning at once the page moves down by the panel's overlap with the header, and a chip already past the foot goes further out.

find: return Math.min(Math.max(want, chip.bottom - height), chip.top - header)
title: moves the page up by the overflow of a panel below its chip, but never the chip under the header
why: The header limit removed: a panel taller than the window moves the page up until the chip is under the header.
